description: This file contains graph pattern matching and decomposition logic for matrix multiplication operations (bmm, addmm, mm) in PyTorch's FX framework, including configuration-based thresholds and device checks.

methods.name: check_device
methods.description: Checks if two tensors are on the specified device type.

methods.name: realize_inputs
methods.description: Marks input nodes to realize their strides for inductor.

methods.name: should_decompose_bmm
methods.description: Determines if a batch matrix multiplication should be decomposed based on shape, device, and configuration thresholds.

methods.name: should_decompose_mm
methods.description: Determines if a matrix multiplication should be decomposed based on shape, device, static shape knowledge, and configuration options.

methods.name: print_decompose_pattern
methods.description: Logs the pattern match for decomposition with input shapes.

methods.name: decompose_bmm
methods.description: Graph pattern for decomposing bmm operations if conditions are met.

methods.name: decompose_addmm
methods.description: Graph pattern for decomposing addmm operations if conditions are met.

methods.name: decompose_mm
methods.description: Graph pattern for decomposing mm operations if conditions are met.
